scenes.summary: Pip finds a map and gathers friends.
scenes.text: Pip the hedgehog finds a map and invites his friends to find the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: hedgehog with animal friends holding map meadow cartoon style
scenes.story: Pip found a treasure map and went on a journey with his friends. They worked together to overcome obstacles and reached a stone cairn. They carefully uncovered a treasure box with seeds and small items. They shared and planted the seeds, making everyone happy. They learned the treasure was meant for all.
